name: Banners
description: Banners and sliders made of templates. A banner is the values of its template's fields — words, pictures, a link, a colour; the template is HTML with {tokens} and CSS, made in the admin or restored from the module's and the theme's presets, and draws a banner as a wide slide, an upright card or a low strip. A slider is a frame template around its slides — where the strip, the dots, the arrows and a second slider beside it stand — placed by a block anywhere on the storefront.
